title: Risk register with mitigation owner assignment
description: Identifies, scores, assigns, and tracks risks with accountable mitigation plans.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: risk-register-mitigation-owners
  title: Risk register with mitigation owner assignment
  description: Identifies, scores, assigns, and tracks risks with accountable mitigation plans.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce an actionable, owned risk register.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - risk-owner-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Scope and stakeholder roster
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - scope
          - stakeholders
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: identify
      kind: agent
      name: Identify risks
      role: Risk analyst
      prompt: Identify operational, financial, legal, technical, and reputational risks. Include triggers and affected
        objectives.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: score
      name: Score risks
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Risk scoring analyst
      prompt: Score each risk using the declared likelihood, impact, and control-effectiveness scales. Return inherent and
        residual scores with calculation traceability.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: mitigate
      kind: agent
      name: Define mitigations and owners
      role: Risk manager
      prompt: Assign one accountable owner per risk and define preventive actions, contingencies, due dates, and residual risk.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: risk-owner-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Risk owners accept assignments
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Risk register with mitigation tracker
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: identify
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: identify
      to: score
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: score
      to: mitigate
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: mitigate
      to: risk-owner-approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: risk-owner-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
